verdict.rationale: Guardrails decide which actions Lindy may take without asking, which implies other actions wait for a human (lindy-docs-8, lindy-docs-24). Email drafting also holds every draft for review, so nothing is sent without approval (lindy-docs-31). However, there is no documented way to insert an explicit pause, approval or input step into a routine, and routines are described as running hands-off on autopilot. Missing for 10: explicit human-in-the-loop approval/input steps for routines, documentation of how pending approvals are surfaced and resumed, a way to collect free-form human input mid-run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
